summary: Build content governance policies, metadata controls, retention workflows, and migration plans. Enroll in practical enterprise training.
lede: Enterprise content governance coordinates how business content is managed from creation through disposal. It is relevant to records, compliance, content-platform and transformation professionals who need to assess repositories and plan controlled migration. The work includes assigning ownership, setting metadata rules, mapping retention and legal holds, and checking migration results.
audienceIntro: This content governance course is designed for professionals who control enterprise information, administer content platforms, manage compliance evidence, or lead repository transformation.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: Working familiarity with records, ECM repositories, compliance controls, or transformation projects. Technology: Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or a compatible spreadsheet application. No coding, scripting, Microsoft Purview license, or SharePoint administrator access is required. Depth: Policy design, metadata mapping, repository assessment, and migration planning receive hands-on operational treatment. Platform configuration, machine-learning model engineering, and enterprise deployment architecture receive conceptual or demonstration-level coverage.
